scope: research-only conclusion proposal and deterministic evaluation writer

observed_problem.description: Each conclusion launched separate CLI processes for proposal and deterministic evaluation; every process replayed the complete refs/proofpress/knowledge history.
observed_problem.effect: O(n^2) local runtime before the single transaction judge call; no provider inference or research condition is changed.

correction.description: Send all evidence-bound conclusions to one research-only process, replay the ledger once, and append the same independent proposal and policy-evaluation events in declaration order.
semantic_invariants: conclusion IDs and digests use the production Proofpress functions
evidence integrity, expiry, supersession, and scope checks remain conclusion-specific
unbound conclusions remain excluded before proposal
task, worker, treatment, policy judge, rubric evaluator, prompts, caps, and provider routes are unchanged

historical_attempts: preserved; in-flight GPT MSA attempt-2 continues with the prior proposal writer
outcome_blinding: frozen before GPT MSA or GPT License produced paired receiver quality results
